correctness.rationale: The central/graph classification and graph-pair permutability criterion follow directly from the Heisenberg central extension. Standard symplectic incidence counts then give the stated total subalgebra count and nonpermutable-pair polynomial for H_2. Exhaustive enumeration over F_2 and F_3 agrees exactly with both formulas.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. arXiv:2609.19086v1 explicitly asks for Heisenberg values and computes H_1 but not H_2. Targeted searches did not locate the H_2 formula or an equivalent extraspecial-group formula. Standard Heisenberg/symplectic structure is treated as prior art, and possible older coverage through finite-group or polar-space terminology remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result solves the next nontrivial Heisenberg case exactly over every finite field and supplies a uniform symplectic criterion reducing all higher-dimensional cases to finite incidence counts.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
